settings.interval_seconds.label: Refresh interval
settings.interval_seconds.description: How often to query the mouse over HID, in seconds.
settings.show_label.label: Show percentage
settings.show_label.description: Show the numeric charge next to the battery icon.
settings.hide_when_missing.label: Hide when disconnected
settings.hide_when_missing.description: Hide the widget if the mouse or receiver is not present.
settings.warning_threshold.label: Low-battery warning
settings.warning_threshold.description: Use the error color at or below this percent while discharging. 0 disables it.
settings.script_path.label: Reader script
settings.script_path.description: Path to glorious-battery.py. Relative paths are inside the plugin directory. Leave as glorious-battery.py to use the installed copy. ~ is expanded.
